messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@wavelabs.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Wavelabs renewal kickoff — capacity incident readiness & QBR slot poll

Hi Alex / Sasha,

Thanks again for the continued partnership — excited to kick off the renewal and the proposed capacity uplift for H2. Goal of this thread: align timeline, stakeholders, and schedule a QBR in the next 3–4 weeks so we can lock the mutual action plan and procurement windows. I attached a draft mutual action plan and a starter QBR agenda to accelerate.

Top items we want to cover in the kickoff:
- Confirm target term and uplift: +35% token throughput and KV cache sizing for peak traffic
- Capacity incident readiness: runbook, SLOs, and escalation path (on-call contacts)
- Procurement / legal milestones and any required evidence (SOC2 excerpts, data handling notes)
- QBR timing: propose Aug 21–25 (please indicate best days/times)

Next steps (proposed):
1) Please confirm procurement contact and whether a PO or contract amendment is preferred.
2) Tell us your preferred QBR day/time window in Aug 21–25.
3) If you have any existing change freezes or release windows in August, flag here so we avoid them.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (draft), qbr-agenda-draft.docx

If helpful, internal owners: Kimberly (Security & Governance), David (Solutions/Capacity), Marissa (CS lead) — I’ve cc’d them.

Thanks — I’ll consolidate replies and push a calendar invite once we have a preferred slot.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee

soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0187

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@wavelabs.ai>

Date: Tue, 01 Aug 2028 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Wavelabs renewal kickoff — capacity incident readiness & QBR slot poll

Hi Soojin — thanks for the clear outline. We’re aligned on the uplift; +35% looks right as a target but we need to validate KV sizing with our infra team first. A couple of quick notes from our side:

- Procurement contact is procurement@wavelabs.ai (looped in if needed). They usually prefer an amendment + PO for mid-year uplifts.
- We do have a product freeze Aug 14–18, so the Aug 21–25 window works better for us.
- We’ll need an on-call escalation runbook — can your SRE/solutions team share a short incident playbook we can review ahead of the QBR?

Prefered QBR slots: Aug 22 or Aug 24, mornings PT. If you can propose 60–75 minute blocks that include a short runbook walkthrough, that’d be great.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform Engineering | Wavelabs
alex.johnson@wavelabs.ai
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Wavelabs renewal kickoff — capacity incident readiness & QBR slot poll

Thanks Alex (and Soojin). Internal follow-up:

- Confirming internal owners: Kimberly (governance/SOC2 excerpts & security evidence), David (capacity sizing + throughput sim), Marissa (customer success & operational readiness).
- We’ll prepare a 1-page incident playbook and a short runbook slide deck (SRE friendly) for the QBR. David, can your team produce a throughput sim for the +35% uplift and share the results before Aug 18?
- Legal/procurement: Soojin, happy to draft the contract amendment template we typically use for mid-term uplifts so procurement@wavelabs.ai has a clean PO flow.

Operational ask list for this thread:
1) David: throughput simulation and KV cache sizing by Aug 15.
2) Kimberly: SOC2 excerpt & data retention blurb by Aug 18.
3) Soojin: lock preferred QBR slot and get procurement looped if amendment required.

I’ll tentatively block Aug 22, 11:00–12:15 PT on our side — please confirm.

— Kim

Great — thanks everyone. Locking in: QBR on Tue, Aug 22, 2028 at 11:00–12:15 PT. Calendar invite coming from me in the next hour (will include dial-in and a short pre-read). Agenda (short):
- 5m: Introductions & objectives
- 20m: Renewal terms & procurement path (Soojin)
- 20m: Capacity uplift plan & throughput simulation (David)
- 15m: Incident readiness / escalation runbook (Kimberly)
- 10m: Open Q&A / next steps

Attachments: I’ve attached the mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (editable) and included the draft QBR agenda in the invite. HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7839 — I’ll update milestones as we progress.

Action items (owners):
- David: share throughput sim by Aug 15.
- Kimberly: SOC2 excerpt + runbook slides by Aug 18.
- Soojin: send contract amendment template to procurement@wavelabs.ai and follow up on PO process.

If procurement would prefer a different contract flow, please flag here and we’ll adapt. Looking forward to the QBR — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
